_about: Free/open-weight models considered for a 10 GB VRAM + 13.6 GiB RAM box. params_b = total parameters from Hugging Face safetensors metadata (fetched 2026-10-07). active_b only where the vendor states it. swe_verified = SWE-bench Verified % with its source; vendor numbers use the vendor's own agent scaffold and are not directly comparable to the official standardized runs.

status_legend.tested: Run and measured on this server (data in benchmarks/results)
status_legend.bringup: Used during GPU/ROCm bring-up with PyTorch/Transformers or llama.cpp smoke tests (no benchmark suite)
status_legend.fits: Fit-analyzed: would run on this box (fully on GPU or via MoE expert offload); not benchmarked
status_legend.split_slow: Dense model larger than VRAM: must split layers GPU/CPU, every weight is read per token -> a few tok/s
status_legend.too_large: Free to download, but needs server-class GPUs or far more RAM than this box has
